newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Gov calls off special tax session.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Gov calls off special tax session.

text.p: Louisiana Gov. Mike Foster has postponed a special legislative session on sales taxes at least until after the regular spring session, a spokesman said Thursday.
The special session had been tentatively set to begin Feb 23 to address foster's proposal to renew a one-cent sales tax. The tax is set to expire on June 30 and raises $110 million annually.

Some lawmakers had balked at extending the tax. Foster's chief of staff, Stephen Perry, said that delaying the tax vote would give lawmakers a chance to draft a bare-bones budget and figure out where the sales tax revenue could be best spent, if it is renewed.
Foster has proposed using it for education, while some lawmakers have said it should go toward the state's struggling Medicaid program.
The regular legislative session is schedulred to begin March 31.
